responsibility: Defines the scheduling model for the Marvell F-class WMMX2/iWMMXt pipeline. It introduces WMMX-specific instruction classification attributes for shifts, packing, ALU, multiply, and transfer classes and assigns reservations and latencies for those classes, plus WMMX load/store timing, so scheduling of iWMMXt instructions can be tuned for this Marvell microarchitecture.
